{{Quote|Do I want to know what ''{{'}}''Bothan Nether Rot''{{'}}'' is?''"<br />"''If you ever develop purple-green discoloration in the trouser area, tell me so I can leave the ship immediately.|The [[Hero of Tython]] and Doc|<ref name="Looking for a Cure" />}}
'''Bothan Nether Rot''' was a disease that affected most [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]], causing a [[Color/Legends|purple-green]] skin discoloration around the upper [[Limb/Legends|legs]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a cure had not been found for the disease, and the combat [[Medic/Legends|medic]] [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Doc]] decided that the disease was not worth his time while searching for a disease to cure.<ref name="Looking for a Cure" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I'll register him as a plague carrier. Give him a nice case of Bothan Nether Rot. That'll keep the girls away.|Kixi|<ref name="Identity Crisis">{{TORcite|type=class|Smuggler|Identity Crisis|Coruscant}}</ref>}}
Bothan Nether Rot was first mentioned in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by [[BioWare]], during the conversation "Looking for a Cure" with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] companion character Doc.<ref name="Looking for a Cure" /> It also appears in the [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] mission "Identity Crisis", where one of the options presented to the player is to have the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Kixiaralu]] edit the records of the smuggler's rival [[Skavak/Legends|Skavak]] so that he will be unable to pick up women. Kixi then edits Skavak's records to state that he is a carrier of Bothan Nether Rot. The name of the disease is the same as that of the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Species/Legends|species]], though it was never confirmed to be related to them.<ref name="Identity Crisis" />
